name: The Hunt for Nekrula, Part 2
description: Find Nekrula's crypt and destroy the vampire lord once and for all.

objectives.description: Destroy all Coffin tokens in the dungeon.

specialRules.description: Whenever a Hero explores and draws a new dungeon tile, place a face-down Coffin token on that tile.
A Hero ending Hero Phase adjacent to a Coffin token may investigate it. If it reveals Nekrula, place Nekrula on that tile.
If Nekrula moves to a tile with an undestroyed coffin, he regains 2 HP at the start of each Villain Phase while the coffin remains.
When Nekrula's Crypt is revealed, if Nekrula is not in play, place him there instead of drawing a Monster. If he is in play, move him there at full HP.

introText: The Heroes follow the mist into Nekrula's hidden crypts for the final battle.
victoryText: Nekrula falls to dust! Peace finally returns to The Shadowhold. The Lands of the Dead is free!
defeatText: Nekrula proves too powerful. The vampire lord's reign of terror continues unchecked.
